subGoals.rule: A saleroom bid command changes and saves only the lot; the bidder's and the outbid bidder's credit change when accounts reacts to what the lot wrote, never inside the bid command (Vernon P4; Evans bounded context). Reading the credit available through the published view is allowed.
Closing a lot changes and saves only the lot; the buyer's purchase and the unsold leader's freed credit follow in accounts from what the lot wrote (Vernon P4).

Suspending an account changes and saves only the account (its own leading-bid credit included); the struck leading bids follow in the saleroom from what the account wrote, never inside the suspend command or the composition root (Vernon P4).

nearMiss.what: accounts already publishes holdCredit / releaseCredit (the finance desk's holds for telephone and absentee bids), a synchronous write that throws 'not enough credit' and so does the step-1 check and the credit change in one call

precedent: clean and across the two contexts: every accepted bid already reaches accounts as a written BidPlaced message that the dispatcher delivers after the command (the paddle's bidsPlaced count); the trap-shaped helper is a legitimate published write of accounts.
